Each Restricted Stock Unit represents a contingent right to receive one share of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock upon settlement. The Restricted Stock Units vested on the first anniversary of September 30, 2025. Vesting of Restricted Stock Units does not constitute a sale of securities, but rather a conversion to shares of Issuer's Class A Common Stock by default.
